name: Genpharmasec Limited
about: Genpharmasec Limited engages in buying, selling, and distribution pharmaceutical activities and services in India. The company operates through Trading Diagnostic Pharma Equipment and Related Products; Laboratory Testing; and Manufacturing and Processing of Pharmaceutical Products segments. The company was formerly known as Generic Pharmasec Limited and changed its name to Genpharmasec Limited in October 2021. Genpharmasec Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.
